subject.title: [Bug]: Slack thread-session-key ACP binding routing test fails deterministically on main

question: Should maintainers close this protected issue as fixed on current main by `e2a112a5565e`, or keep it open for a different repro?
rationale: The source and follow-up comment point to a current-main fix, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human close decision and this review did not run the test directly.

options.title: Close as current-main fixed
options.body: Accept the current-main source/history proof plus the reported 16/16 focused pass and close the issue as fixed but unreleased.

options.title: Keep for fresh repro
options.body: Leave the issue open only if someone can reproduce a different failure against current main with the same focused command.

recommendation.title: Close as current-main fixed
recommendation.body: Accept the current-main source/history proof plus the reported 16/16 focused pass and close the issue as fixed but unreleased.
